label: 已有N65记录的离线分析；不是新仿真
scope: Main N65 one-hour comparison only: N3 v1 rule versus A3-N65 v2 Codex, S5 seeds 0..4.

definitions.final: The JSON's selected report/design/sweep, not necessarily the last Stage4 evaluation.
definitions.band_mask: f_hz >= fc_hz*(1-fbw/2)*(1-1e-9) and f_hz <= fc_hz*(1+fbw/2)*(1+1e-9); band_metrics is called directly.
definitions.centre: Nearest frequency sample to fc, using numpy.argmin, as band_metrics does.
definitions.worst: Largest (least negative) stored S11 dB in band. No interpolation. All exact ties are listed; the first is the scalar frequency.
definitions.band_edge: A worst-frequency sample lies within relative 1e-9 of either nominal band boundary.
definitions.numeric_precision: Trace/report metrics are rounded; final sweep metrics retain the stored sweep precision. Sweep/report differences and very small observed changes are not new precision claims.
definitions.csv_missing: An empty CSV cell means unavailable, not zero. v1 JSONs lack spectre_calls; hf_total is NOT substituted.
definitions.equiv_time_s: Recorded EDA cost-model time, not measured wall-clock duration; recorded_cpu_s and trace_t_s retain their original labels.
definitions.evaluation_events: Only trace agent=refiner,event=evaluate; metrics and violation_* are an electrical-field whitelist.
definitions.consecutive_cid_block: Consecutive Stage4 evaluations with the same cid within one Manager refinement episode. A changed cid or episode starts a new block.
definitions.all_cid_group: All Stage4 evaluations of that cid within one run, including revisits; cids are not shared across runs.
definitions.range_and_improvement: Range=max(S11)-min(S11). First-to-last improvement=first-last; positive means better. Best improvement=first-min.
definitions.deltas: Current S11 minus previous S11; negative means improvement.
definitions.stage2_between: Count of trace impedance_matching events strictly between the group's first and last evaluation. For all-cid groups this may include other candidates.
definitions.stage2_target_change: Compare nf_headroom_db and gain_require_db from each completed Refiner Stage2 trace event with the current candidate's recorded targets. A rejected candidate does not become current. Both keys must be present; explicit null gain target is valid. Only counts are exported.
definitions.action_counts: llm_response_request is parsed role+response <tools> JSON (with project-compatible <answer> fallback), not execution. trace_policy_decision is a v1 decision. trace_completed_or_started_event counts observed events; refine_candidate_started is explicitly a start.
definitions.v1_stage3: v1 does not emit explicit band_planning trace events; its stage3_trace_events field is blank. Stage4 evaluations are not relabelled as Stage3 calls.
definitions.metadata_audit: Metadata tool/args mismatch counts compare only entries with a metadata tool against parsed response JSON. Missing tool and unparsable response counts are separate. metadata_missing_or_mismatched sums missing-tool entries and mismatched entries, without double counting.
definitions.trigger_pair: Two adjacent evaluations in the same episode/cid, with different did, BOTH have gain/nf/ip1db/power violations <=0 and s11>0. Ripple may fail. This is descriptive eligibility, not a replay of a new policy, action-slot check, or proof of improvement.
definitions.inference_limit: Same-cid repeat statistics are observational, not a controlled Stage3 ablation. No claims about simulated results under a new prompt.
definitions.privacy: No design dictionaries, device parameters, raw LLM responses/args, private configurations, credentials, or PDK files are exported.
